title: rcf guidance, the bundle runbook and the overview state the twelve rules and test strength as a report

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] `rcf guidance build-cycle` and the MCP resource `rcf://docs/build-cycle` each state the twelve rules as one list numbered 1 to 12, read as AC-20503-1 reads them (rule 3 under ruling R0 E1, rules 5 and 6 verbatim); the DEFINE section's exit reads "From the named base-suite record, only the newly added or changed test cases fail at the DEFINE head, and each fails at its recorded assertion; an unrecorded baseline failure makes DEFINE BLOCKED. There is no throwaway implementation: the test-author proves red, and green is the builder's to prove."; the REVIEW section runs `rcf audit test-strength` read-only, with no `--record` and no line that test strength is recorded for the reviewer's adequacy verdict, and the TEST section runs `rcf audit test-strength --record`; the FINALISE section says Finalise requires the test-strength record and never refuses on its result. No document `rcf guidance` serves (every topic of `rcf guidance --list`, every `rcf://docs/` resource) and no runbook `rcf build bundle` prints (md, and json `completionContract`) contains "proven red for the right reason", "the suite fails on exactly the new tests" or "test strength is recorded for the reviewer's adequacy verdict", and no such document has a sentence that runs `rcf audit test-strength --record` beside `rcf build verdict review`.

[happy] The runbook `rcf build bundle <fbs> --base-suite <green>` prints, in `--format md` and in the `--format json` `completionContract`, gives the DEFINE stage the rule 6 text ("From the named base-suite record, only the newly added or changed test cases fail at the DEFINE head, and each fails at its recorded assertion; an unrecorded baseline failure makes DEFINE BLOCKED.", with no throwaway), gives the REVIEW stage `rcf audit test-strength` run read-only, with no `--record` among its commands and no line that test strength is recorded for the reviewer's adequacy verdict, and gives the TEST stage `rcf audit test-strength --record` among its commands.

[happy] `rcf guidance overview` keeps "The tool referees structure, never adequacy." word for word, and one sentence says that a gutted test is shown by the test-strength report ("the test-strength report shows it") and that the reviewer judges it.
